create_entity_instance: create an Entity instance with a name and properties dictionary for world modeling
get_property_from_entity: get a specific property value from an Entity using the get_property method
set_state_on_entity: set state properties on an Entity using the set_state method with a state dictionary
create_room_entity: create a Room entity to represent a room in the robot's world model
create_object_entity: create an Object entity to represent a small movable object in the world
